title: Video: Nvidia rules out Huang comeback as campaign for his return grows, sources say
html:
Reuters

Nvidia's board is not weighing a return for Jensen Huang as CEO, three people told Reuters, despite a growing campaign for his return days after affairs involving employees and suspected Chinese intelligence ties forced his resignation.
